validation_logic: city, start_time, available_minutes, return_deadline, return_location must be present and parseable
failure_or_action: Reject planning until required fields are provided

validation_logic: planned elapsed time from start through return <= available_minutes, when the user supplies a duration
total duration includes travel between stops and travel from final stop to return location
each scheduled stop has a sourced or explicitly marked estimated duration
failure_or_action: Ask for or use labelled demo estimate; never mark unknown estimate as verified

validation_logic: scheduled visit must fit within reliable, date-specific opening hours
failure_or_action: Exclude stop or request verification when hours conflict or are unknown

validation_logic: sum of available supported prices must fit the requested hard budget; unknown prices must be disclosed
failure_or_action: Reject or warn depending on whether user marked budget strict

validation_logic: score attractions by overlap with selected interests
failure_or_action: Use as ranking preference, never override a hard constraint

validation_logic: each factual claim must retain a source and evidence status, or be marked unknown/inference
failure_or_action: Do not label unsupported claims VERIFIED

validation_logic: record_type= Synthetic placeholder must never be displayed as a real-world venue
failure_or_action: Limit synthetic records to tests or explicitly labelled demos

validation_logic: routing or LLM failures must be visible in warnings/errors
failure_or_action: Use documented fallback only; label demo estimates

validation_logic: if no sequence satisfies hard constraints, return infeasible status
failure_or_action: Do not fabricate a feasible itinerary

validation_logic: last route leg must terminate at requested return_location
failure_or_action: Reject itinerary without a verified/configured return endpoint

validation_logic: ratings and review counts can change; preserve timestamp/last_checked if available
failure_or_action: Display source and freshness warning; do not assert current rating without re-check
